source_instruction: i'm looking for a toothpaste for teeth whitening in blueberry scent
query: Ugh, you would not believe the chaos I ran into on the walk over to the store five minutes ago! That fluffy golden retriever that hangs out on the corner of Maple and Third got loose from his owner’s grip, bolted straight for the giant puddle left by last night’s thunderstorm, and shook so hard he splattered mud all over the front of my brand-new light gray hoodie. I stood there flabbergasted for a second while the owner apologized a mile a minute, and honestly I couldn’t even be mad—he was just so excited chasing a sparrow that hopped across the sidewalk, his whole tail wagging so hard his whole body wiggled. I ducked into the corner bodega first to grab a pack of wet wipes to scrub at the splotches, and it’s already fading a little, so I don’t think the stain will set if I throw it in the wash as soon as I get home. Hey, I’m looking through the toothpaste section right now. I need one that does teeth polishing, y’know? Grab that one flavor I always get, yeah? Don’t pick anything too expensive, just keep it reasonable, thanks.
